sources.title: GitHub - akivet/Mica-v0.1-4B
sources.snippet: The largest gap is a note inside the state that tells the model to pick a wrong option: Mica still gets 69.1 % right, JEV 17.5 %, Kev 31.4 %, base Qwen3.5-4B 1.0 %. The same note pointing at the right option lifts Mica to 88.7 %, so such notes still move it.
